description: Remove the hidden location, camera details, dates and comments from a JPEG, PNG or WebP photo without changing the picture. Saves next to the original as name-clean unless output is set.

keep_color_profile.description: Keep the colour profile so colours look the same. Defaults to true.

output.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to the image's name with -clean, in the same folder.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

name: image_strip_metadata
title: Remove image metadata
